race.comment: GLOBAL ECLIPSE (1) relished the rise to the mile last time at Doomben and always looked the winner. Suspect he will be even better stretching to this trip and the low draw should have him blending into it beautifully. GIAPPONESE (4) is better judged on his second at this venue two starts back than his effort in the Lismore Cup where he got too far back. Can rebound quickly on the short turnaround. DOWN UNDER STUNNAH (11) made solid late ground when resuming at Doomben over the mile and is entitled to improve second-up. DATA LEAK (6) comes through the same race, where he too got motoring late. Drawn to take closer order this time and keeps a claimer on to get him in light at the weight. Have to throw him in exotics. SAVEUR (12) has been looking for a trip and gets something more to her liking here, though the wide gate could force her too far back.
